entries.snippet: The Cultural Landscape Foundation, a nonprofit advocacy organization, is asking a federal judge to halt President Trump's plans to resurface the reflecting pool on the National Mall.

entries.title: Why cruise ship passengers with possible hantavirus exposure went to Nebraska

entries.title: New poll finds a majority of Americans unsure if attempts on Trump's life were real
entries.snippet: When given the options of "true," "false" or "not sure," and asked whether each of the incidents "was staged," a majority of respondents said they thought each event was either staged or were unsure.

entries.title: Abortion pill by mail allowed for at least 3 more days, the Supreme Court says
entries.snippet: Full access to the abortion pill mifepristone, including through telemedicine and the mail, will continue for at least three more days, the high court said on Monday.

entries.snippet: Oregon's public schools rank last in fourth-grade reading, according to an analysis of national testing. As a wake-up call for elected leaders, Pencil is running for governor as a write-in candidate.

entries.title: Trump nominates David Cummins to head the TSA after a rocky period for the agency
entries.snippet: Cummins worked as a senior vice president at Serco, a government contractor.

entries.title: Trump nominates Cameron Hamilton to lead FEMA, a year after he was fired from the role
entries.snippet: The nomination suggests a shift in the administration's stance on FEMA, which has faced criticism from President Donald Trump.

entries.title: The barista is human but an AI agent runs this experimental Swedish cafe
entries.snippet: The coffee might be poured by a human hand, but behind the counter something far less traditional is calling the shots at an experimental cafe in Stockholm.

entries.title: Democrats ask Supreme Court to halt a Virginia ruling blocking new congressional districts
entries.snippet: Democrats on Monday filed an emergency appeal with the U.S. Supreme Court seeking to halt a Virginia ruling invalidating a ballot measure that would have given their party an additional four winnable U.S. House seats.

entries.title: Supreme Court temporarily extends access to a widely used abortion pill
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court is leaving women's access to a widely used abortion pill untouched until at least Thursday, while the justices consider whether to allow restrictions on the drug, mifepristone, to take effect.

entries.title: How a crisis of conscience spurred this Christian IVF doctor's career pivot
entries.snippet: A Tennessee doctor is practicing reproductive medicine aligned with his Christian faith. His clinic draws patients nationwide who are concerned over the moral issues that surround in vitro fertilization.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump says 'I hope it's fine' when asked about hantavirus outbreak
entries.snippet: Some experts have said U.S. authorities were slow to respond, but President Donald Trump said he thought the response was, "I think fine."

entries.title: WATCH: Trump compares imprisonment of Jimmy Lai to James Comey, but says he'll bring it up to Xi
entries.snippet: The U.S. president said he'll bring up the Lai's plight in China this week, though he compared the pro-democracy activist to one of his most detested foes.

entries.title: EU targets Russians with sanctions over the abduction of thousands of Ukrainian children
entries.snippet: The European Union has imposed sanctions on 16 officials accused of helping Russia abduct tens of thousands of children from Ukraine.

entries.title: Israeli troops will spend weeks in military prison for desecration of Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
entries.snippet: Israel's military said the soldier posing would get 21 days in military prison and the soldier who photographed it would get 14.

entries.title: Lawsuit accuses ChatGPT of helping gunman plan FSU mass shooting
entries.snippet: The lawsuit says the alleged gunman Phoenix Ikner relied on ChatGPT to determine what type of gun to use and which location would allow for the most potential victims, among other information.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Iran war: Trump says ceasefire 'on life support'
entries.snippet: After rejecting Tehran's response to the US peace proposal, President Donald Trump warned that the ceasefire in the war with Iran was "on life support." Follow DW for the latest.

entries.title: Ukrainian children held in Russia: militarized, 'reeducated'
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian initiative to repatriate abducted Ukrainian children reports that at least 20,000 girls and boys are being held by Russian families and authorities. Can these children ever find their way home?

entries.title: Slovenia, Spain and Ireland won't air Eurovision over Israel's participation
entries.snippet: The three European countries are boycotting the popular song contest over Israel's participation in it. More countries have said they won't be taking part.

entries.title: White House press dinner shooting suspect pleads not guilty
entries.snippet: A California man has been charged with attempting to assassinate Trump at the White House Correspondents' Association dinner.

entries.title: Hantavirus: How is the outbreak being contained as passengers return?
entries.snippet: Passengers evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship are returning to their home countries, some with symptoms, many without. What happens to these people and what is being done to contain the spread?

entries.title: EU greenlights sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlers
entries.snippet: Long blocked by Hungary's former government, the punitive EU measures are aimed at "extremist" Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. Israel has denounced the move as "arbitrary and political."

entries.title: Religion steers Bengal politics in Bangladesh, India — again
entries.snippet: Bengal, a region known for its secular traditions, is seeing a rise of religion in politics as Islamists grow stronger on the Bangladesh side of the border and Hindu nationalist BJP takes power in India's West Bengal.

entries.title: Architecture of remembrance and hope: Daniel Libeskind at 80
entries.snippet: Famous for designing the Jewish Museum Berlin and the Ground Zero project in New York, the architect has created dozens of memorable buildings worldwide.

entries.title: Hantavirus: How it differs from COVID
entries.snippet: In 2018-2019, the Andes virus hantavirus spread person-to-person in Argentina. Eleven people died — but it was stopped. Analysis of that outbreak shows the current one can also be stopped.

entries.title: Germany news: 1-in-6 retailers fear for future
entries.snippet: About one-in-12 German businesses worry about survival, with twice as many retailers jittery. Meanwhile in Stuttgart, five pro-Palestinian activists face trial over attacking an Israeli defense company site. Follow DW.

entries.title: Nigeria's solar boom faces cost and policy barriers
entries.snippet: Nigeria's rising solar imports signal a search for alternatives to unreliable grid power and high fuel costs. But adoption is being held back by steep upfront prices, limited financing and policy uncertainty.

entries.title: Ukraine: EU sanctions Russians over 'systematic unlawful deportation' of children
entries.snippet: The EU is sanctioning 16 individuals and seven entities over alleged child abductions. The UK also issued fresh sanctions, and Germany's defense minister visited Kyiv amid a shaky ceasefire. DW has the latest.

entries.title: What will happen to Iran's nuclear material?
entries.snippet: Iran is believed to have over 440 kilograms of enriched uranium, which could be turned into weapons-grade nuclear material. Despite Trump's pledge to get the "nuclear dust," Tehran has kept it out of US reach.

entries.title: Philippine lawmakers move to impeach VP Sara Duterte
entries.snippet: Lawmakers in the Philippines have voted for proceedings to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte. A Senate trial could remove her from office and block any 2028 presidential run.

entries.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer 'not walking away' after local election mauling
entries.snippet: Keir Starmer has said he takes "responsibility" for Labour's poor election performance, but also for putting matters right again. "I know I have my doubters and I know I need to prove them wrong, and I will," he said.

entries.title: Endemic, epidemic, pandemic: What's the difference?
entries.snippet: The Andes hantavirus outbreak shows how easily disease labels are misunderstood — and why they describe patterns of spread, not how dangerous a virus is.

entries.title: Hantavirus: Evacuated passengers begin returning home
entries.snippet: Passengers on the ill-fated cruise from several European countries, including Germany, are returning home and will be screened by health authorities. One French woman developed symptoms on the return flight.

entries.title: Nazi-looted artwork surfaces with Dutch collaborator's heirs
entries.snippet: A Nazi-looted painting from a famed Dutch collection has surfaced in the home of decendents of a senior Nazi collaborator. The painting’s wherabouts became known after a relative discovered the truth.

entries.title: Somali piracy adds new strain to global shipping and trade routes
entries.snippet: As ships reroute around Africa to avoid Middle East conflict zones, piracy off Somalia is back. The resurgence is driving up insurance, transit times and security costs, putting new pressure on global supply chains.
